description: The Scheepvaartmuseum occupies the old naval arsenal on the Oosterdok: a large square storehouse of pale stone-colored plaster, with angled buttresses and a central pediment. A wooden full-rigged ship lies quiet alongside, with no readable name. The sky is overcast, about 16.2°C, with wind near 7.6 km/h. The glass courtyard roof is indoors. NEMO is outside this frame. The museum is closed.
